item.text:
`test/orders.js` exports four small order helpers: `calcTotal(items)` sums `price * qty` for each item, `applyDiscount(total, code)` applies `SAVE10`/`SAVE20`, `averageItemPrice(items)` derives an average from the order total, and `formatOrder(order)` renders line items plus a discounted total.

Bugs:
- [test/orders.js](/abs/path/not/available) lines 5-6: `for (let i = 0; i <= items.length; i++)` iterates one past the end. On the last iteration `items[i]` is `undefined`, so `items[i].price` throws.
- [test/orders.js](/abs/path/not/available) line 17: `averageItemPrice` divides the full order total by `items.length`, but `calcTotal` already includes `qty`. For items with quantities above 1, this returns “average per distinct line item”, not “average item price”. If the intent is per unit average, it should divide by total quantity.
- [test/orders.js](/abs/path/not/available) line 18: `items.length === 0` produces a divide-by-zero result (`NaN` via `0 / 0`), so empty input is not handled.

Risk note: the off-by-one in `calcTotal` is a hard crash path and also breaks `averageItemPrice` and `formatOrder`, since both depend on it.
